scripts.game:anno: nodemon -q --watch packages/reconciler/dist --watch packages/utils/dist --watch packages/core/dist --watch packages/game/dist --watch packages/anno/dist -e js --delay 500ms --exec "yarn workspace @jsxcad/anno start"
scripts.game:paleo: nodemon -q --watch packages/reconciler/dist --watch packages/utils/dist --watch packages/core/dist  --watch packages/testing/dist --watch packages/game/dist --watch packages/paleo/dist -e js --delay 500ms --exec "yarn workspace @jsxcad/paleo start"
scripts.dev: cross-env FORCE_COLOR=1 npm-run-all --parallel -l watch:anno serve game:anno
scripts.dev:paleo: cross-env FORCE_COLOR=1 npm-run-all --parallel -l watch:paleo serve game:paleo
scripts.build: node scripts/cleanup.ts && yarn workspaces foreach -A --topological-dev run build
